extension.description: Live Streaming, Replay the last week, Film, Documentaries, On-Demand programs, News and Weather, Podcast, Search
Diretta Live, Rivedi ultima settimana, Film, Documentari, Programmi On-Demand, Telegiornali e Meteo, Podcast, Cerca
extension.news:
8.0.0 (2026-11-21) - Plugin renamed to LA7 Play - Removed all the old la7.it code, the config file and the "requests" dependency - New Film and Documentaries sections (replaces LA7 Prime), sorted by date; documentaries include series episodes - Search reworked on the la7play.it search API: programs and videos, with next pages - News & Weather: removed Edicola and Meteo della Sera (no longer updated) - Removed LA7 Eventi Live - Real episode and film description shown in the player (from the video page) - Programs list with portrait posters, new icons for Search, Film and Documentaries - New menu order and localized day/month names (English and Italian)
7.3.0 (2026-11-03) (thanks @fabpolli) - Added Podcast section - Removed Personalities section, no longer available on the LA7 site
7.2.0 (2026-10-29) (thanks @fabpolli) - Migration to the new la7play.it site (Live, Replay, Programs, Movies, News & Weather) - Search function adapted to la7play.it
